rules.title: ⚠️ Update now — this version can freeze or crash when you open a channel
rules.message: You are on PremiumTV {version}. This build has a serious bug: opening a channel can leave the picture frozen on black or crash the app, especially when a channel switches to another server. PremiumTV 1.0.9 fixes it — please update right away. Tap “Get 1.0.9 now” and use Settings → App updates. If you are on 1.0.8.1 and it still says “up to date”, it will now offer 1.0.8.2 — install that and then 1.0.9 appears automatically. You can also tap “Open download page” below to get the APK directly. It installs over this build and keeps your settings and favorites.
rules.surprise: Why Settings may have said “up to date”: this build still thinks 1.0.9 is a copy of itself, so the in-app check can miss the fix — bridge 1.0.8.2 fixes that lie. Install it once and 1.0.9 appears. From 1.0.9 on there are no more “V patches”: every fix is simply the next version, and the app updates itself again. The popup now also has an “Open download page” button for one-tap manual install.

rules.title: This preview was retired — install PremiumTV {newest}
rules.message: You are on PremiumTV {version}. That 1.1.x preview channel was retired: its downloads are gone and it is not the stable app. PremiumTV {newest} is the stable release now — install it from the download page. On Android it installs over this build with no uninstall; on Mac the DMG replaces this copy.
rules.surprise: 1.1.0 is a full stable release: the category rail with the docked side player, tap-to-full-screen, automatic server backup, amber pointer outlines, dead channels filtered out and a calm loading screen — plus every fix from 1.0.9.

rules.title: PremiumTV {newest} is ready — you are on {version}
rules.message: You are on PremiumTV {version}, and PremiumTV {newest} is waiting. Open Settings → App updates and press Check for update, then Download update and Install update. It downloads once, verifies against the release SHA-256 file, and installs right over this build. Support for builds below {newest} ends {support_ends}, so update before then to keep receiving channel and guide refreshes.
rules.surprise: PremiumTV 1.1.0 is the biggest release yet: a category rail beside the channel list, a side player docked on the right that goes full screen on one press, automatic server backup that keeps a live event playing when a feed dies, an amber outline on whatever the remote is pointing at, dead channels filtered out of the browser, and a calm loading screen with the gold loading line kept. Settings → App updates installs it for you.

after_support_ends.title: Support for PremiumTV {version} ended on {support_ends}
after_support_ends.message: This build no longer receives channel or guide updates. Install {newest} to keep live channels and every future update in-app.
after_support_ends.surprise: Stable {newest} still updates itself: Settings → App updates verifies the installer's SHA-256 and installs it for you.

rules.title: A newer PremiumTV is waiting — and this is the last manual install
rules.message: You are on PremiumTV {version}, and {newest} is waiting on GitHub. Update once and PremiumTV keeps itself current from then on. Support for this build ends {support_ends}.
rules.surprise: Here is the surprise: the newest build updates itself. Settings → App updates checks GitHub, downloads the installer once, verifies it against the release's SHA-256 file and hands it to the normal installer — so you never download an APK or a DMG by hand again. 1.1.0 adds the category rail, the docked side player, automatic server backup and dead-channel filtering.

after_support_ends.title: Support for PremiumTV {version} ended on {support_ends}
after_support_ends.message: This build no longer receives the GitHub channel scrape updates, so its channel list is frozen at {support_ends}. Install the newest release from GitHub to keep getting live channels and every future update in-app.
after_support_ends.surprise: The newest build still updates itself: Settings → App updates checks GitHub, verifies the installer's SHA-256 and installs it for you.
